release_allowlist_source: GitHub vauxr-ai/vauxr non-draft non-prerelease releases verified 2026-11-11
latency_counts: disjoint completed-session duration buckets; sum equals sum(outcomes)
counter_limit_action: Stop admitting completed observations when total outcomes reaches 1000000; outcome and latency bucket admitted together
queue_overflow_action: drop oldest complete queued report, never modify retained payloads
wire_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, booleans as integers, unknown fields and incorrect types before mutation
timestamp_rules: All timestamps whole UTC seconds with Z suffix and valid calendar dates
created_at >= interval_end for interval or started_at for startup
interval_start and interval_end minus one second must share UTC hour, date and month
month equals UTC month of interval_start or started_at
created_at and interval_end or started_at must be <= receipt UTC + 300 seconds
receipt UTC - created_at <= 604800 seconds AND receipt UTC - interval_start or started_at <= 604800 seconds
Attribute interval totals to UTC date of interval_start; startup to UTC date of started_at; never receipt date
identity_rules: Random UUIDv4 monthly identity; no previous identity field or linking
Persist month high-water mark; on backward month discard identity and suspend collection/transmission until month reaches high-water mark
UTC month transition finalizes previous interval with previous identity; new interval gets new identity
Disable cancels in-flight requests, blocks future work and clears queue/identity; retain only nonidentifying clock high-water mark
collection_rules: No collection or network before authenticated notice acknowledgment; env false overrides persisted/UI enabled before startup scheduling
Default enabled preference is not consent acknowledgment
One logical startup beacon per process start only if collection gate allows; retries reuse exact serialized bytes
Split counters at UTC hour/midnight/month while collecting, not collector apportionment
No lifetime totals; atomic durable transaction seals interval, enqueues immutable payload and resets counters
Provider/model category counts are independent marginal counts, never paired dimensions; custom endpoints or unknown names map to custom
Official release version emitted only for verified official release build provenance; matching version string in custom build is insufficient
logical_expiry_rules: Expired raw/dedup/hourly rows excluded from queries even before asynchronous TTL deletion
Use accepted receipt UTC plus 2592000 seconds for raw/dedup expiry; hourly bucket end plus 2592000 for hourly expiry
Atomic report-ID absent insert plus daily and hourly increments; duplicate ID never increments, even if body differs
latency_constraints: Sum latency_ms buckets equals sum outcomes; each bucket maximum 1000000
startup_count exists only in startup; interval cannot increment startup count
